english.title: Fail to keep animals not intended for immediate slaughter at holding of destination for 30 days

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to keep

(A)_[an animal]_
(B)_[animals]_

not intended for immediate slaughter, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL(S)..), at the holding of destination, namely **(..SPECIFY DESTINATION..), for at least 30 days
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 8(3) of Schedule 2 to and regulations 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
failed to keep animals not intended for immediate slaughter
at the holding of destination for at least 30 days

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies to elephants and to cattle, pigs, sheep, goats and all other animals of the taxa artiodactyla, and their crossbreeds
(ii) See separate offence under paragraph 8(2) in relation to 'animals intended for immediate slaughter' - H11510
(iii) This offence is not committed in a case where the animals in question have been consigned from the holding direct to a slaughterhouse
(iv) For an offence committed before 14/12/19, please use offence wording H11511
